log: 'on Krea 2 Turbo, whose CFG box is classifier-free guidance, the panel\'s and the grid\'s labels say plain CFG: only FLUX.1\'s distilled guidance is qualified'
'The prompting guide: the checkpoint text under both ? badges, the size line against its documented range, and the Examples menu'

expect: els.sizeHint.classList.contains('warn') && els.sizeHint.textContent.includes('below the 1 MP this checkpoint is documented for')
els.examplesMenu.hidden && els.prompt.value === 'a fox walking in the snow'

eval: fetch('/api/grid', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({prompt: 'a {size} fox in the snow', prompt_axis: 'size = big | small', steps_axis: '6,8,10', cfg_axis: '0,1', width: 1152, height: 896, seed: 42})}).then(r => r.json()).then(j => { window.__run = j.run_id; })

log: 'a close of the users own hands focus to the card the walk ended on, not the one it was opened from'
'The sheet lists a variable as the grid declared it, not alphabetically: size = small | big reads small, big'

eval: window.__grid = (body) => fetch('/api/grid', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({seeds: 2, seed: 20, width: 512, height: 512, ...body})}).then((r) => r.json()); window.__heads = (cls) => [...document.querySelectorAll('#sheet-grid .' + cls)].map((e) => e.querySelector('.label').textContent).filter(Boolean).join();
window.__grid({prompt: 'a {size} owl', prompt_axis: 'size = small | big'}).then((j) => { window.__owls = j.run_id; })

log: 'Under Favorites the order is the run it came from: big starred on the first seed and small on the second still read small, big'
'A comparison with one image per version loaded still gives the versions the rows: a star each, Favorites on'

eval: window.__grid({prompt: 'a red fox', seeds: 4, prompt_variants: [{label: 'original', prompt: 'a red fox'}, {label: 'reordered', prompt: 'fox, red'}, {label: 'rewrite', prompt: 'A red fox in the snow'}]}).then((j) => { window.__foxes = j.run_id; })

api('/api/gallery?limit=100&search=run:' + window.__foxes).then((p) => { window.__fox = (label, seed) => p.items.find((r) => r.variables.variant === label && r.seed === seed); return Promise.all([['original', 21], ['reordered', 21], ['rewrite', 23]].map(([l, s]) => setFavorite(window.__fox(l, s), true))); })

log: 'And a star each on its own seed: the seeds run across the versions rather than being pinned to one'

eval: Promise.all([['original', 21, false], ['reordered', 21, false], ['original', 20, true], ['original', 22, true], ['rewrite', 21, true]].map(([l, s, on]) => setFavorite(window.__fox(l, s), on)))

log: '(the two runs are deleted again, so the page of 48 below still reaches the planted images)'

eval: Promise.all([window.__owls, window.__foxes].map((run) => api('/api/gallery?limit=100&search=run:' + run).then((p) => Promise.all(p.items.map((r) => api('/api/images/' + r.id, {method: 'DELETE'}))))))

log: 'The checkpoint scope: the two images planted under another checkpoint are hidden until All models is ticked, and the tick says how many'

expect: total >= window.__scoped + 2 && els.otherModels.textContent === '' && galleryRecords.filter((r) => r.model_id !== loadedModel).length >= 2

log: 'Pre-rename browser state migrates to the Local Diffusion key'
'Another tab writes the store while this one is open: a change here writes back only what this page changed, never its own older prompt, grid spec and steps over that tab work'

eval: window.__until = async (fn, ms = 20000) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { if (await fn()) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } return false; }; window.__stored = () => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('local-diffusion.panel.v1') ?? 'null');

const other = {...__stored(), prompt: 'written by another tab', gridSteps: '20,28,36', gridOpen: true}; other.sampling = {...other.sampling, steps: '40'}; localStorage.setItem('local-diffusion.panel.v1', JSON.stringify(other));

expect: __stored().prompt === 'written by another tab' && __stored().gridSteps === '20,28,36' && __stored().gridOpen === true && __stored().sampling.steps === '40' && __stored().sampling.model === loadedModel && els.prompt.value === 'remembered' && !els.gridSection.open

log: 'what this page changes wins, key by key'
'an empty store - the other tab Reset - takes this whole panel, sampling checkpoint and all'

eval: els.batch.value = '1'; els.seed.value = ''; els.prompt.value = 'remembered'; els.prompt.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true}));

log: 'Reset: every box back to the checkpoint defaults, the store forgotten, and nothing remembered across a reload'

eval: els.steps.value = '12'; els.steps.oninput(); choose('16:9', 2); els.gridSection.open = true; els.gridSteps.value = '6-12x2'; els.batch.value = '4'; persistPanel();

expect: els.prompt.value === '' && els.steps.value === '8' && els.width.value === '1024' && els.gridSteps.value === '' && !els.gridSection.open && els.batch.value === '1' && localStorage.getItem('local-diffusion.panel.v1') === null

log: 'Woken by CFG, the negative costs nothing more: Krea 2 runs its uncond pass from 0 up whatever the box holds, and the caption says so where the greyed one said what waking it costs'

expect: els.negNote.textContent === '(runs at CFG > 0, no extra cost)'

log: 'The grid' + "'" + 's examples are the profile' + "'" + 's own neighbourhood: 8 steps give 6,8,10, and a CFG-0 profile keeps 0,0.5,1 - one below would be negative'

eval: els.prompt.value = 'a fox'; els.negative.value = '{avoid}'; els.gridPrompt.value = 'avoid = blurry | dark | noisy'; els.gridCfg.value = '0,2'; els.gridSection.open = true; previewGrid();
els.negative.value = ''; els.gridPrompt.value = ''; els.gridCfg.value = ''; els.gridSection.open = false; els.seed.value = ''; persistPanel();

expect: window.__asked.length === 1 && window.__asked[0].includes('Delete ' + window.__n + ' unstarred images') && window.__asked[0].includes('keeping ' + window.__k + ' starred') && window.__asked[0].includes('a fox')
total === window.__n + window.__k && els.galleryError.textContent.includes('is not ' + window.__n)
total === window.__k && galleryRecords.every((r) => r.favorite) && document.querySelectorAll('.card').length === window.__k
els.galleryError.textContent.includes('Moved ' + window.__n + ' images to the recycle bin') && els.bin.querySelector('.count').textContent.trim() !== ''
